messages:
mike_support: FYI customer /acct-493 is seeing repeated 504s and timeouts hitting hosted API around 09:12 UTC, impact across multiple routes. They sent curl logs and latency spike graphs.
nora_support: customer is on Standard tier, no dedicated capacity. They reported: "requests queue then gateway 504s, retries don't help". Repro link: https://s3.redwood/escals/acct-493/packet-capture.log
emma_oncall: I pulled ingress logs — saw long upstream timeouts, backend responded with 502/504s. KEDA metrics show no scale events during the spike.
jess_engsre: can you paste the ScaledObject/ HPA config for that namespace? suspect scaler metric mismatch or annotation TTL too long.
mike_support: pasted below (redacted):
```
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: model-inference-scaledobj
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: inference-deployment
  triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata:
      serverAddress: http://prom:9090
      metricName: queue_length
      query: sum(rate(request_queue_total{app="inference"}[1m]))
      threshold: "50"
  cooldownPeriod: "300"
  pollingInterval: "60"
```
liam_runtime: aha — pollingInterval 60s + cooldown 300s is aggressive for bursts. If the queue jumps faster than polling, KEDA doesn't emit a scale. Also Prom query uses rate[1m] which smooths short bursts.
nora_support: customer says they had a burst of ~200 concurrent requests at T0. Provisioning took ~90s but traffic kept arriving and gateway started returning 504s after 30s.
emma_oncall: readiness probe logs show pods took ~40s to become Ready due to model init (cold weights load). The autoscaler needed time plus kube scheduling.
jess_engsre: immediate mitigation options: 1) bump minReplicas to handle expected peaks, 2) reduce pollingInterval to 5s and cooldown to 90s, 3) pre-warm pods or use a lighter init path. Which can we push now?
liam_runtime: we can quickly patch ScaledObject pollingInterval -> 5, cooldownPeriod -> 120 and change query to use instant queue_length (not rate). I'll open a PR. But changing polling for all tenants risky — scope to namespace for this customer only.
deploy-bot: deploy started for namespace acct-493 — patch scaledobject pollingInterval=5. (build 0.3.7)
emma_oncall: after the patch we saw two scale events within 12s and new pods started. However pod init still ~35-45s, so customer saw a reduction in 504s but not full elimination.
mike_support: customer acknowledged improvement but still reported tail 504s during sustained bursts. They're asking for a post-incident plan and temporary credits.
jess_engsre: follow-ups: 1) document recommended ScaledObject parameters for bursty queues (polling 5s, cooldown 120-180s, query window 30s), 2) add an autoscale runbook entry to consider minReplicas for Standard-tier customers when model init >30s, 3) expose pre-warm API flag for hosted inference, 4) short-term credit offer.
liam_runtime: longer-term: add keda alert when no scale events are emitted but queue_length > X for Y seconds; also investigate faster model init (lazy weights load) or snapshot/rest store to reduce cold start.
nora_support: I've filed INC-2026-813 and added customer notes + offered 10% credit for the last billing period.
miкe_support: (typo corrected) mike_support: assigning owners: jess to lead postmortem, liam to runtime changes, emma to oncall follow-up. Will loop in account exec for credits.
jess_engsre: quick repro steps we documented for internal ops: 1) simulate 200 RPS spike with steady pre-spike 5 RPS 2) verify KEDA doesn't scale if pollingInterval > spike duration 3) confirm readiness probe delays add to total coldstart. I'll drop the perf graphs in the doc.
liam_runtime: PR merged for acct-493 only. I'll schedule a config rollout to other at-risk tenants after we validate perf for 24h.
emma_oncall: closing incident channel in 2h if no regressions. Will keep monitoring dashboards and set a temporary alert: queue_length > 30 for 30s with no scale event -> page oncall.
mike_support: thanks team. Customer follow-up scheduled for 15:00 UTC. Final note: remind solutions to recommend Dedicated for customers with predictable high bursts or long model init. :thumbsup:
